meta.name: brainstorm-okrs
meta.description: Brainstorm team-level OKRs aligned with company objectives — qualitative objectives with measurable key results. Use when setting quarterly OKRs, aligning team goals with company strategy, drafting objectives, or learning how to write effective OKRs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定与公司目标对齐的团队 OKR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为团队设定可衡量的季度目标
copy.tagline_en: Brainstorm team OKRs aligned with company objectives
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set measurable team goals for the quarter

howto.what: 当用户要求制定团队OKR时，Claude会扮演资深产品负责人，根据公司战略和团队背景，生成三套包含定性目标和定量关键结果的OKR方案，并保存为Markdown文件。
howto.when: 当用户提出制定季度OKR、对齐团队目标与公司战略、起草目标或学习如何写OKR时触发。

say.text: 帮我为数据团队 brainstorm 下季度的 OKR。
我们团队的目标是提升用户留存，请给出三套OKR。
say.note: Claude会结合公司战略生成方案。

howto.what_en: When asked to brainstorm team OKRs, Claude acts as a veteran product leader, generating three sets of OKRs (qualitative objectives with quantitative key results) aligned with company strategy, and saves them as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to set quarterly OKRs, align team goals with company strategy, draft objectives, or learn how to write effective OKRs.

say_en.text: Help me brainstorm next quarter's OKRs for the data team.
say_en.note: Claude will generate three OKR sets.

say_en.text: Our team aims to improve user retention. Give me three OKR sets.
say_en.note: Claude will align with company strategy.
